clusters.headline: Ethiopia: UN Voices Concern Over Worsening Security Situation, Armed-Group Coalition and Drone Strikes in Ethiopia
clusters.summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- The United Nations has expressed deep concern over what it described as a worsening security situation in Ethiopia, citing the formation of a new coalition of armed groups, continued insecurity and reports of drone strikes.

clusters.headline: Africa: NITDA, NDPC and Galaxy Backbone Back CyFrica 2026 as Nigeria's Leading Cybersecurity Summit Returns
clusters.summary: [CyFrica] As Nigeria's digital economy accelerates towards an estimated $18.3 billion in 2026, the country is confronting an equally urgent challenge: protecting the digital infrastructure, data and financial ecosystems powering that growth.

ASEAN aims to bring upgraded goods trade pact into force by end-2026, ahead of schedule: Gan Kim Yong
clusters.summary: The ASEAN Trade in Goods Agreement will simplify and clarify trade rules, making it easier for businesses to operate across ASEAN and facilitating greater intra-regional trade.

clusters.headline: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
clusters.summary: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

clusters.headline: Texas ICE shooting leaves Venezuelan DoorDash driver with bullet in his back, says lawyer
clusters.summary: The delivery driver was transferred from a hospital to a detention centre, his lawyer tells US media.

clusters.headline: Two charged with woman's murder as South Africa police investigate eight other body finds
clusters.summary: The body of Jabulile Ntimba was the ninth to be found recently in an area east of Johannesburg.

clusters.headline: How Tollyjoy grew from a 100-worker Singapore factory to a regional brand over 55 years
clusters.summary: Founded by Mr Tan Khung Ngee and his wife, Madam Tan Hong Keow, in 1971, the family business later passed to their son who had initially hoped to pursue medicine.

clusters.headline: Soaring living costs have many Nigerian couples rethinking the lavish wedding tradition
clusters.summary: Nigeria's lavish wedding tradition is colliding with a cost-of-living crisis, forcing young couples to rethink how they say "I do."

clusters.headline: World leaders convene for UNGA. And, Trump says D.C. arch will be a 'military complex'
clusters.summary: This week, world leaders convene for the U.N. General Assembly as war continues in Ukraine and the Gulf. And, President Trump has proposed that his arch serve as a military complex.

clusters.headline: Leaders set ambitious goals to better the world by 2030. They've made little progress
clusters.summary: In 2015, global leaders set ambitious goals to reduce inequality, end hunger and boost education. More than a decade later, the world is nowhere near achieving much of what was promised.
